verdict.rationale: Migration credits are a fair pricing question for a cloud hosting platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no migration-credit program. The Pro plan's "$20/month in usage credit" is a standard plan allowance, and the Enterprise SLA credits compensate for downtime. Neither is a credit for moving production infrastructure onto Vercel. The "Migrate an existing Docker app" guide is technical documentation, not a pricing incentive.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can receive migration credits when moving my production infrastructure to a new platform
